```yaml
name: Bump Personal Server After Release

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  bump-version:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install make

      - name: Run validation checks
        run: |
          make lint
          make test
          make workflow-security-checks

      - name: Update version in control file
        run: |
          sed -i "s/^Version:.*/Version: ${{ github.ref_name }}/" hushline-personal-server/DEBIAN/control

      - name: Update version in docker-compose file
        run: |
          sed -i "s/image: scidsg\/hushline-personal-server:.*/image: scidsg\/hushline-personal-server:${{ github.ref_name }}/" hushline-personal-server/var/lib/hushline/docker-compose.yaml

      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "GitHub Actions"
          git config --global user.email "actions@github.com"
          git add hushline-personal-server/DEBIAN/control hushline-personal-server/var/lib/hushline/docker-compose.yaml
          git commit -m "Bump personal server version to ${{ github.ref_name }}"

      - name: Create pull request
        id: create_pr
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.PERSONAL_SERVER_VERSION_BUMP }}
          title: "chore(personal-server): bump version to ${{ github.ref_name }}"
          body: |
            This PR bumps the version of the personal server to match the latest Hush Line release.
          base: main
          head: bump-${{ github.ref_name }}

      - name: Merge pull request
        if: steps.create_pr.outputs.pull_request_merged == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/auto-merge-action@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.PERSONAL_SERVER_VERSION_BUMP }}
          pull-number: ${{ steps.create_pr.outputs.pull_request_number }}
```
